metadata.description: Unified scheduler + dispatcher for agent routines with global difficulty routing and explicit provider pins.

schemas.name: RoutineStatus
schemas.purpose_statement: One slim status row per routine for admin delivery

field_descriptions.routine_fleet_bucket_key: the stable routines fleet hash bucket for one routine
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_order_key: the routine status, display group identifier, and routine identifier joined by # in that order
field_descriptions.routine_identifier: the stable identifier of one scheduled routine
field_descriptions.routine_schedule_status_text: the active or paused state recorded in a routine schedule
field_descriptions.routine_harness_name: the configured agent harness name for a routine
field_descriptions.routine_model_name: the configured model name for a routine
field_descriptions.routine_schedule_rule_text: the recurrence rule text for a routine schedule
field_descriptions.routine_display_group_identifier: the identifier of the display group for one routine
field_descriptions.routine_display_group_label: the display label of the group for one routine
field_descriptions.routine_next_fire_time_text: the next routine dispatch time as RFC 3339 text, or empty when no dispatch is due
field_descriptions.routine_last_run_time_text: the last routine run time as RFC 3339 text, or empty when no run exists
field_descriptions.routine_last_exit_code_text: the decimal exit code of the last routine run, or empty when no completed code exists
field_descriptions.routine_running_flag_text: the text true or false that reports whether a routine run is active
field_descriptions.routine_harness_process_identifier_text: the decimal operating system process identifier of an active routine harness, or empty when absent
field_descriptions.routine_current_run_stamp: the run stamp of the active routine execution, or empty when absent
field_descriptions.routine_current_run_directory: the filesystem directory of the active routine execution, or empty when absent
field_descriptions.routine_current_start_time_text: the active routine start time as RFC 3339 text, or empty when absent
field_descriptions.routine_dispatch_fence_text: the routine dispatch fence state as false, true, or a Situation identifier
field_descriptions.routine_last_run_outcome: the classified outcome of the most recent routine execution
field_descriptions.routine_last_run_outcome_detail: the bounded explanation of the most recent routine execution outcome
field_descriptions.routine_recent_noop_rate_text: the recent no-op fraction as decimal text, or empty when no completed outcomes exist
field_descriptions.routine_recent_useful_rate_text: the recent useful-outcome fraction as decimal text, or empty when no completed outcomes exist
field_descriptions.routine_outcome_window_count_text: the decimal count of recent routine outcomes that form the reported rates
field_descriptions.routine_status_content_sha256: the SHA-256 digest of the bounded routine status fields excluding the digest and capture time
field_descriptions.routine_record_update_time_text: the RFC 3339 text for the publication time of a stored routine status or run record

schemas.name: RoutineRunSummaryV2
schemas.purpose_statement: A bounded run summary keyed by routine and run stamp; each row stays below 8192 bytes and log_tail stays below 2048 bytes

field_descriptions.routine_identifier: the stable identifier of one scheduled routine
field_descriptions.routine_run_stamp: the stable timestamp stamp that identifies a run under one routine
field_descriptions.routine_run_start_time_text: the routine execution start time as RFC 3339 text, or empty when absent
field_descriptions.routine_run_finish_time_text: the routine execution finish time as RFC 3339 text, or empty when the execution has no finish
field_descriptions.routine_run_exit_code_text: the decimal routine execution exit code, or empty when no code exists
field_descriptions.routine_run_outcome: the classified outcome of one routine execution
field_descriptions.routine_run_outcome_detail: the bounded explanation of one routine execution outcome
field_descriptions.routine_run_duration_ms_text: the decimal routine execution duration in milliseconds, or empty when no completed duration exists
field_descriptions.routine_run_log_tail_text: a bounded redacted suffix of routine execution output without its complete logs or prompts
field_descriptions.routine_record_update_time_text: the RFC 3339 text for the publication time of a stored routine status or run record

schemas.name: FleetSummary
schemas.purpose_statement: A bounded fleet manifest with counts and a digest; each row stays below 4096 bytes

field_descriptions.routine_fleet_identifier: the identifier of one routines fleet
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_capture_time_text: the RFC 3339 text of the time a routines fleet publication was captured
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_layout_version_text: the decimal version text of the stable routines fleet bucket layout
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_bucket_count_text: the decimal count of stable hash buckets in a routines fleet
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_record_count_text: the decimal number of routine status records in a complete fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_active_count_text: the decimal number of active routine schedules in a fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_paused_count_text: the decimal number of paused routine schedules in a fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_fenced_count_text: the decimal number of fenced routine schedules in a fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_running_count_text: the decimal number of active routine executions in a fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_error_count_text: the decimal number of routines whose latest recorded outcome is an error
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_run_summary_count_text: the decimal number of recent run summaries selected for a fleet publication
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_posture_read_flag_text: the text true or false that reports whether the fleet posture read succeeded
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_posture_error_text: the error from a failed fleet posture read, or empty when the read succeeded
field_descriptions.routine_fleet_content_sha256: the SHA-256 digest of the complete sorted routine identifier and status-digest pairs
